OVERVIEW: Alive2 stand-alone translation validator:
version v21.0-92-g1d1bc4fe
see alive-tv --version for LLVM version info,

This program takes either one or two LLVM IR files as
command-line arguments. Both .bc and .ll files are supported.

If two files are provided, alive-tv checks that functions in the
second file refine functions in the first file, matching up functions
by name. Functions not found in both files are ignored. It is an error
for a function to be found in both files unless they have the same
signature.

If one file is provided, there are two possibilities. If the file
contains a function called "src" and also a function called "tgt",
then alive-tv will determine whether src is refined by tgt. It is an
error if src and tgt do not have the same signature. Otherwise,
alive-tv will optimize the entire module using an optimization
pipeline similar to -O2, and then verify that functions in the
optimized module refine those in the original one. This provides a
convenient way to demonstrate an existing optimizer bug.

Multiple "src" and "tgt" functions can be specified in the same file
by postfixing, after "src" and "tgt", either a unique integer or an
'_' followed by an arbitrary string. For example if the file contains
the following functions "src", "tgt", "src4", "tgt4", "src_foo",
"tgt_foo", "src_bar", "tgt5", then the pairs "src" <-> "tgt", "src4"
<-> "tgt4", and "src_foo" <-> "tgt_foo" will be verified but "src_bar"
and "tgt5" will unused.

USAGE: alive-tv [options] first_bitcode_file [second_bitcode_file]

  --always-verify                - Verify transformations even if they are syntactically equal

import random, sys

def gen(seed, cfg=False):
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    ty = rnd.choice(['i8','i16','i32','i64'])
    bw = {'i8':8,'i16':16,'i32':32,'i64':64}[ty]
    mask = (1<<bw)-1
    nargs = rnd.choice([2,3,4])
    args = ['a','b','c','d'][:nargs]
    vals = list(args)
    nder = rnd.randint(0,4)
    derived = []
    for i in range(nder):
        op = rnd.choice(['add','sub','mul','and','or','xor','urem','udiv','lshr'])
        x = rnd.choice(vals); y = rnd.choice(vals)
        flags = ''
        if op in ('add','sub','mul'):
            flags = rnd.choice([' ',' nuw ',' nsw ',' nuw nsw '])
        elif op in ('lshr','shl'):
            flags = rnd.choice([' ',' nuw '])
        name = 'd%d'%i
        derived.append('%s = %s%s %s, %s' % (name, op, flags, x, y))
        vals.append(name)
    consts = []
    pool = [0,1,2,3,5,7,-1,-2,-3,-5, mask>>1, (mask>>1)+1, mask]
    for _ in range(3):
        v = rnd.choice(pool)
        consts.append(str(v if v>=0 else v))
    cvals = [str((c & mask) - (mask+1 if c & (1<<(bw-1)) else 0)) if False else str(c) for c in []]
    # format constants properly
    def fmt(c):
        c = int(c)
        if c < 0:
            return str(c)
        return str(c & mask)
    consts = [fmt(c) for c in rnd.sample(pool, 3)]
    vals_c = vals + consts
    preds = ['ult','ule','ugt','uge','slt','sle','sgt','sge','eq','ne']
    def mkcmp(i):
        p = rnd.choice(preds)
        x = rnd.choice(vals_c); y = rnd.choice(vals_c)
        return (p,x,y)
    facts = [mkcmp(rnd.randint(0,1000000)) for _ in range(rnd.randint(1,3))]
    checks = [mkcmp(rnd.randint(0,1000000)) for _ in range(rnd.randint(1,3))]
    lines = []
    lines.append('declare void @llvm.assume(i1)')
    lines.append('define %s @t(%s) {' % (ty, ', '.join('%s %s'%(ty,ar) for ar in args)))
    lines.append('entry:')
    for d in derived:
        lines.append('  %s' % d)
    for i,(p,x,y) in enumerate(facts):
        lines.append('  f%d = icmp %s %s %s, %s' % (i,p,ty,x,y))
        lines.append('  call void @llvm.assume(i1 f%d)' % i)
    res = None
    for i,(p,x,y) in enumerate(checks):
        lines.append('  c%d = icmp %s %s %s, %s' % (i,p,ty,x,y))
        lines.append('  z%d = zext i1 c%d to %s' % (i,i,ty))
        if res is None:
            res = 'z%d'%i
        else:
            lines.append('  r%d = xor %s %s, %s' % (i,ty,res,'z%d'%i))
            res = 'r%d'%i
    lines.append('  ret %s %s' % (ty,res))
    lines.append('}')
    return '\n'.join(lines)+'\n'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.stdout.write(gen(int(sys.argv[1])))

  cmp -s $D/$b.src.ll $D/$b.oldn.ll && continue
  out=$(timeout 90 alive-tv $D/$b.src.ll $D/$b.oldn.ll 2>&1)
  bad=$(echo "$out" | awk '/incorrect transformations/{print $1; exit}')
  echo "### $b bad=${bad:-?}"
  if [ "x$bad" != "x0" ]; then
     echo "$out" | grep -E "Incorrect|ERROR|Transformation" | head -5
     cp $D/$b.src.ll /tmp/ce/dt_BAD_$b.ll
  fi
done
echo ALLDONE
EOF
